titles.title: The Coachman and the Young Lady

description:
Countess Ellie and her coachman, Cole, witness a man and a woman intertwined in her private villa. Escaping the awkward situation, the two ultimately decide to spend the night in the carriage.

"I'm trying to sleep, but my corset is uncomfortable... Could you help loosen it just a little?"

Starting from that night, the desires they had tried so hard to suppress begin to slowly reveal themselves...     

Will the two be able to overcome the wall of social status and claim their forbidden love...?
